Class ElmCatalog

java.lang.Object
network.ike.foundation.ike.elm.ElmCatalog
public final class ElmCatalog extends Object
The ELM node catalog read back from the store: every node kind, its base, and its positions with what each holds, how many, and in which form (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1110). The catalog is knowledge, generated into the starter set from HL7's ELM schemas by ike:schema-import; this class reads it, never restates it, so the builder and the checker are driven by data.
